lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: The highest-intensity local maxima are organized into approximately four horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region. These roughly circular clusters are spaced with relative regularity, forming a grid-like arrangement across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible intersecting the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating distinct anchor nodes. This grid-like pattern is most prominent in the central region of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three dominant linear features run horizontally across the upper third of the flank. These features are defined by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity, with high-luminance highlights on the dorsal edge and dark shadow regions on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The right pectoral fin is prominently visible in the lower foreground, displaying a high-density patterning of small, irregularly shaped high-luminance spots that are significantly smaller than the primary flank blobs.
